title: "svelte/no-reactive-reassign"

A value that `$: name = ..` computes is overwritten the next time the statement runs, so assigning it elsewhere is lost. The rule reports assignments, `++`, `delete`, array methods that change it such as `push()`, and `bind:`, also of its properties. It looks at components that are not in runes mode.

{/* Generated by src/codegen/lint-rule-docs.ts. Do not edit this section. */}

## Configure

Off by default. It runs on the Svelte components that an ESLint config lints with `svelte-eslint-parser`, in the place of the rule of `eslint-plugin-svelte`:

{/* skip */}

```js eslint.config.js
import svelte from "eslint-plugin-svelte";

export default [
  ...svelte.configs.recommended,
  { rules: { "svelte/no-reactive-reassign": "error" } },
];
```

{/* End of the generated section. */}

## Examples

Reported:

{/* bad */}

```svelte
<script>
  export let price;
  $: total = price * 2;
  const reset = () => (total = 0);
</script>
```

Not reported:

{/* good */}

```svelte
<script>
  export let price;
  $: total = price * 2;
  const reset = () => (price = 0);
</script>
```

## Options

| Option  | Default | What it does                                                          |
| ------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `props` | `true`  | Also report changes to properties of the value: `total.count = 0`      |
